name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple stable branches. The latest release is v0.61.2 (OSS) / v1.61.2 (Enterprise), tagged on May 19, 2025 (https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases/tag/v0.61.2). Concurrent maintenance releases are being issued for the v0.60.x, v0.59.x, and v0.58.x branches, indicating a mature multi-version support policy. Detailed per-release changelogs are linked from each release page but were not rendered in the provided changelog text.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several branches in May 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed hosting) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, Spark SQL, MongoDB, Presto/Trino, Druid, Oracle, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau provides richer visualization and enterprise features than Metabase but is proprietary, expensive, and not self-hostable in the same open-source sense.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash is tightly integrated with dbt and offers a metrics-layer approach, but has a smaller ecosystem and requires dbt familiarity unlike Metabase.
